newsitem.title: UK: Little movement in copper in LME evening trade.
newsitem.headline: Little movement in copper in LME evening trade.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) copper price showed little movement in evening inter-office trading, and business was slow.
There was no news to shake the market from its recent trading range although technical traders still reckoned the break would be on the downside, when it comes.
Three months delivery at 1845 GMT was quoted at $1,971/$1,973 compared with $1,970/$1,971 at the end of the afternoon trading session on the LME floor.
